compute_adjacent_positions: compute the six adjacent block positions to a given 3D coordinate in Minecraft
cluster_intersecting_areas: cluster a list of cubic areas by merging intersecting ones into unified regions
determine_line_of_sight: determine the block in an entity's line of sight capped at a max distance
find_object_looked_at: find which candidate object a player is looking at based on yaw and pitch
convert_to_block_position: convert a floating point coordinate array to an integer Minecraft block position
